spec_match.rationale: Runs the exact contract from PR 672's IDL: prototype instanceof EventTarget, direct-parent identity, inherited-not-copied method identity, own-property absence, and the onmaxwritewithoutresponsesizechanged handler — each shown as its literal expression.

interactive.rationale: Step/walk/restart buttons drive a real Object.getPrototypeOf walk with own-property listings per link; run-all-checks evaluates seven real expressions; the family table renders live per-interface results.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises the hardware-free exact-contract probe and family comparison; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Three headline branches (157 contract present / interface present but pre-157 / interface absent with exact Linux flag remedies), checks report thrown ReferenceErrors distinctly, and the family table surfaces the real Chrome spec-gap on BluetoothRemoteGATTService.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5138797158334464, the spec PR preview, and siblings.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's script assertions are one-to-one with this page's checks, including the negative gattserverdisconnected-stays-on-device contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified in headless Chromium 141 twice: without flags (interface absent — honest walk refusal, checks throw ReferenceError) and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features (interfaces present, server correctly reports pre-157 non-inheritance; family table dumped and inspected). Both device classes clean via CDP, zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on headline probe, each walk step, and each checks run with pass counts.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; hit-link highlight uses emerald border with charcoal text; table verdict colours on paper/stone at AA.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with disabled management, aria-live chain and checks lists, real table with caption and scoped headers, focusable code block.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow on either class (long identifiers wrap; table scrolls inside its wrapper); CDP-verified.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the passing path on Chrome 157 Canary when available
openQuestions.detail: Every check's true-branch is code-reviewed but the environment's Chromium 141 can only produce the two fallback branches. On a 157 build the headline should flip green and all seven checks read true; confirm the family table then shows the server in the yes column.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap long monospace content; scrollable table wrappers instead of clipped tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Chain rows use overflow-wrap:anywhere; the family table sits in .table-scroll.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout panel accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce incrementally-added list content politely; keep verdicts textual.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Chain and checks lists are aria-live=polite; every verdict is a word (true/false/threw), never colour alone.

summary: The hardware-free heart of the feature: ancestry as a runnable probe. Exercised in both no-API and flag-enabled pre-157 states in headless Chromium 141; the 157 true-path awaits a Canary pass.
